goal.notEnabledForAsset: Attack goal "{{goal}}" targets security goals ({{goals}}) not enabled for asset {{asset}}

completeness.leafNoEvaluation: Leaf node "{{name}}" has no risk evaluation
completeness.pathNoMitigations: Path to "{{name}}" has no mitigations assigned

coverage.missingGoals: Attack tree does not cover security goals: {{goals}}

rating.mixedMethods: Node "{{name}}" mixes rating methods: attack potential cannot be combined with probability. Rate all children the same way.

impact.ignoredWithAsset: Impact on "{{name}}" is ignored — it is derived from asset {{asset}} and the tree's security goal.
impact.ignoredGeneric: Impact on "{{name}}" is ignored — impact belongs to the damage scenario (asset × security goal), not to an attack step.

iso.methodNotImplemented: ISO mode requires an implemented, audit-grade feasibility method (RC-15-11). "{{method}}" is not implemented yet. Use attack-potential.
iso.methodQuick: ISO mode requires an implemented, audit-grade feasibility method (RC-15-11). Quick mode is a drafting mode, not audit-grade. Use attack-potential.
iso.probabilityLeaf: ISO mode: leaf "{{name}}" uses a probability (p,i), which is not an RC-15-11 feasibility method. Rate it with the project's {{method}} method.
iso.extendedLeaf: ISO mode: leaf "{{name}}" uses f,b,i, which is not an RC-15-11 feasibility method. Rate it with the project's {{method}} method.
iso.leafMethodMismatch: ISO mode: leaf "{{name}}" is not rated with the project's feasibility method ({{method}}).
iso.benefitAnalysisOnly: ISO mode: benefit on "{{name}}" is analysis-only and never enters the risk number (Cl. 3.1.29).

parser.multipleRoots: Multiple ROOT nodes found. Only one ROOT allowed.
